title: ‘भत्किँदै किल्लाहरू’ कथा सङ्ग्रहमा उत्तरआधुनिकतावाद
nepali: लेखसार प्रस्तुत अध्ययनमा कथाकार डा. दीनबन्धु शर्माको ‘भत्किँदै किल्लाहरू’ कथा सङ्ग्रहमा प्रयुक्त कथाहरूमा उत्तरआधुनिकता सिद्धान्तको खोजी गरिएको छ । उत्तरआधुनिकतावादअन्तर्गत नारीवाद, विनिर्माणवाद, नवइतिहासवाद, नवमाक्सवाद, नवमनोविश्लेषणवाद जस्ता सिद्धान्त स्थापित छन् । त्यसैगरी उत्तरआधुनिकतावादमा आधुनिकतावादले नछोएका, नसमेटेका र नदेखेका विषयवस्तु र क्षेत्रहरू पर्दछन् । स्थानीयता, बहुलता, विशृङ्खलता आदि पक्षलाई उत्तरआधुनिक साहित्य सिद्धान्तले अङ्गीकार गर्दछ । कृतिको विधागत संरचना र भाषाशैलीमा नवीनतम् प्रयोग अपेक्षित हुन्छ । ‘भत्किँदै किल्लाहरू’ कथासङ्ग्रहमा विषयवस्तुको नवीनतम प्रयोग गरिएको छ । कथानकको सङ्गठन र शृङ्खलालाई वृत्ताकारीय बनाइएको छ । मिथकको प्रयोग गरिएको छ । यौन मनोविज्ञानलाई नवीन रूपमा उजागर गर्न खोजिएको छ । स्थापित मूल्य, मान्यता, विचार, दृष्टिकोण र परम्परालाई विनिर्माण बनाइएको निष्कर्ष यस अध्ययनम निकालिएको छ ।
american_english: Abstract: In the present study, an exploration of postmodern theory has been conducted within the stories featured in story writer Dr. Dinbandhu Sharma's story collection 'Bhatkindaikillaharu' (Collapsing Fortresses). Under postmodernism, theories such as feminism, deconstruction, new historicism, neo-Marxism, and neo-psychoanalysis are established. Likewise, postmodernism encompasses subject matters and domains untouched, uncovered, and unseen by modernism. Postmodern literary theory embraces aspects such as locality, plurality, and decentered fragmentation. Innovative experimentation in the generic structure and linguistic style of a work is expected. In the story collection 'Bhatkindaikillaharu', novel experimentation with subject matter has been carried out. The organization and sequencing of the plot have been rendered circular. Myth has been employed. An attempt has been made to reveal sexual psychology in a novel manner. The conclusion is drawn in this study that established values, norms, ideas, perspectives, and traditions have been deconstructed.

informal_english: Abstract: In this study, we take a good squiz at postmodern theory through the stories in short-story writer Dr Dinbandhu Sharma's collection 'Bhatkindaikillaharu' (Collapsing Fortresses). Under postmodernism, you've got established frameworks like feminism, deconstruction, new historicism, neo-Marxism, and neo-psychoanalysis. Likewise, postmodernism takes on subjects and areas that modernism never touched, missed out on, and never even saw. Postmodern literary theory really gets behind things like local identity, plurality, and fragmentation. You naturally expect plenty of fresh experimentation across the genre structure and linguistic style of a work. In the story collection 'Bhatkindaikillaharu', there's heaps of innovative experimentation with the subject matter. The organisation and sequence of the plot have been made completely circular. Myth has been brought into play as well. An effort has been made to unpack sexual psychology in a fresh way. This study winds up concluding that established values, norms, ideas, points of view, and traditions have all been properly deconstructed.
